note: Cases built from traits/trait_validator.rs and traits/mounts.rs: validate_endpoint_mounts (a trait on a protocol page and a route page, or only on an endpoint and rendering UI) and validate_orbital_init_fetch (a persistent entity read by route-mounted body traits that no trait fetches on INIT). The programs are resolved .orb fixtures and the expected findings are the ones the core checks report (`program/validate`). The first case covers the embed closure (a trait embedded by a route trait is route-mounted), a toast-only helper and a trait with no render. The third and fourth cover the controls of the INIT rule: a datasource fetch, `ref`, a fetch below a `do`, an INIT arm leaving another state or `*`, an array `from`, a runtime entity, an entity with no persistence declared, a toast slot, a content slot, a `@config` slot, a creating trait, guard, tick and whole-entity reads, and a fetch of another entity.
